mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_district(district_id, province, city, city_geocode, district, district_geocode, lon, lat) VALUES(#{districtId}, #{province}, #{city}, #{cityGeocode}, #{district}, #{districtGeocode}, #{lon}, #{lat}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE province = VALUES(province), city = VALUES(city), city_geocode = VALUES(city_geocode), district = VALUES(district), district_geocode = VALUES(district_geocode), lon = VALUES(lon), lat = VALUES(lat)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT province FROM weather_district ORDER BY province
SELECT DISTINCT city AS city, city_geocode AS cityGeocode FROM weather_district WHERE province = #{province} ORDER BY city
SELECT id, district_id, province, city, city_geocode, district, district_geocode, lon, lat FROM weather_district WHERE district_id = #{districtId}
